title: City Attorney report and Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to authorize the use of Rapid Micro-trenching in accordance with…
text:
[Council File 24-0041]
City Attorney report and Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to authorize the use of Rapid Micro-trenching in accordance with requirements established by the City Engineer and subject to a Street Damage Restoration Fee payment matching that of regular Micro-trenching.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to authorize the use of Rapid Micro-trenching with a Street Damage Restoration Fee matching regular Micro-trenching.
